==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Reached Challenger rank 1 for the first time in May 2017 (Season 7)<ref>[http://twitter.com/EliayLipp/status/859028064998707202/photo/1 Upset, first time Challenger rank 1]</ref>.
* Top 1 of the EUW solo queue ladder achieved on May 1 2021<ref>[https://twitter.com/FNC_Upset/status/1388552597355778053/photo/1 Upset, EUW sQ rank 1]</ref>.
* Married Chilean streamer [[Paulaeal]], the former owner of [[Humanoids5]], on August 3, 2021 <ref> [https://twitter.com/FNC_Upset/status/1422580071840296962 Upset's tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on March 6, 2022.
** The 10th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Perkz]], [[nukeduck]], [[Caps]], [[Wunder]], [[Kobbe]], [[Hans sama]], and [[Odoamne]].
* Reached 1500 kills in the LEC on January 26, 2025.
** The 6th player to reach 1500 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Caps]], [[Perkz]], and [[Hans Sama]].
* Dealt 1,804 DMG/M playing {{ci|Zeri}} in their week 8 win against [[Team Vitality]] during [[LEC/2022 Season/Summer Season|LEC Summer 2022]], breaking the seven year old record of [[Pepiinero]].

=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x LEC Season MVP (Spring 2025)
* 3x LEC 1st All-Pro Team (Summer 2018, Spring 2022, Spring 2025)
* 3x LEC 2nd All-Pro Team (Spring 2019, Summer 2019, Spring 2020)
* 2x LEC 3rd All-Pro Team (Spring 2021, Summer 2021)
